name: com.mememychess/replay
title: MemeMyChess
description: Review chess games with meme reactions and open a replay at the move that triggered each meme.

tools.name: inspect_game_pgn
tools.description: Parse a user-supplied PGN and return the games and public game headers. The PGN is sent to MemeMyChess for legal-game validation.

pgn.description: A user-supplied PGN. Maximum UTF-8 size is 5 MiB.

tools.name: get_game_positions
tools.description: Return legal board positions for one game in a user-supplied PGN. Each FEN is the board before the move in that row. Results omit engine and media details.

pgn.description: A user-supplied PGN. Maximum UTF-8 size is 5 MiB.

game.description: One-based game number in the PGN.

tools.name: review_meme_game
tools.description: Prepare a Chess Memes review of one selected game using MemeMyChess story compilation. Returns only viewer-facing meme moments, their moves and board squares, a truthful summary, and a replay link when the PGN fits the browser-link limit. Games with no supported meme moments report zero moments.

pgn.description: A user-supplied PGN. Maximum UTF-8 size is 5 MiB.

game.description: One-based game number in the PGN.

tools.name: open_meme_moment
tools.description: Open one selected meme moment in the browser replay. The one-based moment number follows the ordered moments returned by review_meme_game. The URL includes the full PGN, selected game and moment, and anyone with the link can read the PGN.

pgn.description: A user-supplied PGN. Maximum UTF-8 size is 5 MiB.

game.description: One-based game number in the PGN.

moment.description: One-based meme moment index from review_meme_game.

tools.name: roast_my_game
tools.description: Create one shareable, expiring friend link for a funny authored moment involving the side the user played, or a terminal loss to the other side. The link opens directly into a short single-move replay with its meme; the supplied PGN is not included. Games without a relevant authored reaction return no roast or link.

pgn.description: A user-supplied PGN. Maximum UTF-8 size is 5 MiB.

game.description: One-based game number in the PGN.

tools.name: create_replay_link
tools.description: Create a MemeMyChess browser replay URL carrying a PGN and selected game in its URL fragment. Anyone with the link can read the PGN.

pgn.description: A PGN up to 150,000 characters for a practical browser URL.

game.description: One-based game number in the PGN.
